hooks.command: repo="${QODER_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -n "$repo" ] || { echo "worker-hook: cannot resolve repo root from cwd=$PWD" >&2; exit 0; }; bash "$repo/bootstrap/run-interactive-worker-hook.sh" qoder SessionStart
repo="${QODER_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -n "$repo" ] || exit 0; bash "$repo/bootstrap/run-interactive-worker-hook.sh" qoder SessionEnd
